svg.title: GainSec — night block, beyond GitHub
svg.desc: Night-time city block in a neon-noir style, showing work published beyond GitHub. Each building is one category of publication series (publications grouped by venue): height = log of its item count, lit windows = 12 minus the months since its latest item (12 lit = published this month, dark = nothing for a year). Hand-bent tube signs name each category, a small plaque under it names each of its series with its item count, and the fascia plaque gives the category total; one letter (P) is a dead tube. A dot-matrix ticker counts milestones by kind: no counts. 5 categories of 11 series with 112 items in total; buildings, left to right: Vulnerability / Security Research (32 items, latest 2026-10-04, 12/12 windows lit; series: Flock Safety Research 12, Software Vulnerability Disclosures 9, Hardware + Embedded Security 4, Verkada / Verkracked Research 3, Automotive, V2X + Connected Infrastructure 3, Other Connected Public Safety + Surveillance Research 1); Technical Walkthroughs (45 items, latest 2025-10-18, 0/12 windows lit; series: Technical Walkthroughs 45); Offensive Tooling (4 items, latest 2026-09-17, 11/12 windows lit; series: OSINT Research 4); Open / Public Source Projects (20 items, latest 2026-10-19, 12/12 windows lit; series: Project Releases + Engineering 20); Everything Else (11 items, latest 2025-09-01, 0/12 windows lit; series: Technical Leadership 3, Lectures, Papers + Media 8). Localised signs (hk): 營業中 = open for business (Traditional). Legend: BUILDING = CATEGORY; HEIGHT = LOG ITEMS · PLAQUE = COUNT; LIT = 12 − MONTHS SINCE LATEST ITEM.

svg.text: Night block, beyond GitHub — 5 categories as buildings (sign = category, plaques = its series with item counts, height = log items); lit windows = 12 − months since the last item.
